subject: English
passage:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes:
• Dr. Kavya Hegde studies marine biology at the University of California.
• Hegde's research team recently discovered a new species of deep-sea coral.
• It is the first bioluminescent coral species found in the Pacific Ocean.
• It was discovered in the Mariana Trench off the coast of Guam.
prompt: The student wants to indicate where the coral species was discovered. Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?

choices.A: Hegde's team recently discovered the first bioluminescent coral species found in the Pacific Ocean.
choices.B: Dr. Kavya Hegde, of the University of California, is part of a research team.
choices.C: The coral species was discovered in the Mariana Trench off the coast of Guam.
choices.D: The coral, which is a new deep-sea species, exhibits bioluminescent properties.

explanation:
Choice C is the best answer. The sentence indicates where the coral species was discovered: the Mariana Trench off the coast of Guam.

Why A is incorrect:

Choice A is incorrect. The sentence states that Hegde's team discovered the coral species; it doesn't specify where they found it.
